title: Patrick Ewing 2024 Prizm Draft Picks #20 Georgetown Hoyas
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks trading card featuring Patrick Ewing of the Georgetown Hoyas and later the New York Knicks. This specific card is part of the base set and is a Silver Prizm parallel/variety. It is a non-autographed card and is part of the National Basketball Association (NBA) league. Perfect for basketball fans and collectors looking to add a unique piece to their collection.
